base_member_text: Header comment @L46 'VESSEL is a module to model ship-wakes' is copied from mod_vessel.F and does not describe this tracer module
audit_member_text: Copy/paste metadata defect: L46 describes VESSEL and ship wakes, but the implemented module is TRACER at L54 and contains only particle tracking procedures.

base_member_text: Cross-line: dry-cell revert test @L397 sums MASK(nx2(I),ny2(I)) twice and never checks MASK(nx3(I),ny3(I)) - the third triangle vertex mask is ignored
audit_member_text: Copy/paste logic defect: the rollback dryness test at L397 sums MASK at vertex 1 and vertex 2 twice, omitting the separately stored vertex 3 (nx3,ny3 restored at L402-L403 and used by interpolation at L515/L519 and subsequent layer branches). A dry/wet state unique to vertex 3 cannot affect rollback.

base_member_text: Exact float comparison Sc(I)==0.0 @L509 guards the division; degenerate cells only produce a stdout warning and freeze the tracker velocity update
audit_member_text: Ineffective singularity guard: MOVE_TRACER rejects only exact Sc(I)==0.0 at L509, then divides weighted velocities by Sc(I) at L516, L520, L525, L529, L534, and L538. Near-degenerate triangles with very small nonzero area pass the check and can create unbounded tracer velocities; no SMALL/tolerance test is used.

base_member_text: Loop index I used in DO I=1,NumTracker (L193, L395, L434, L470, L482, L507, L569) is not declared in this module (only II,JJ @L69) - it must be host-associated from USE PARAM/GLOBAL; the module-level I is shared state across these subroutines

Usurf,Vsurf,Ubott,Vbott allocated @L128 and read in MOVE_TRACER (L513-529) but never assigned in this file - surface/bottom velocity fields must be filled elsewhere or remain undefined for LAYER_012=1,2 trackers
BROADCAST_XY: when IN_CELL is true on multiple ranks the highest rank index l wins (L470-477); npxs/npys gathered @L428-431 but never used; IDsend @L424 unused; commented MPI_Barrier @L440

TRACK_TIME_COUNT @L70 and FirstCallTrack @L78 declared/initialized but never used in this file; PLOT_INTV_TRACKING is read @L123 but the output cadence logic using it is not in this file (PLOT_COUNT_TRACKING only zeroed @L174)
Tracker file is re-read allocation (L125-127) occurs before the IF(.NOT.ALLOCATED(Sc)) guard (L136) - calling TRACER_INITIAL twice would re-ALLOCATE X_TRACK etc. without deallocation
Search area convention: areas computed with vertex order such that clockwise order gives negative area (comment L183-184); containment requires area1,area2,area3>=0 (L259, L301)
OUTPUT_TRACKING keeps units 8/9 open for the whole run; under PARALLEL only rank 0 writes but all ranks hold identical positions after BROADCAST_XY

audit_member_text: MPI use-before-assignment defect: X_TRACK_ALL, Y_TRACK_ALL, and IN_CELL_ALL are populated only inside myid==0 blocks at L442-L466, but the selection loop at L470-L477 is outside any root guard and reads these automatic local arrays on every rank. Non-root ranks therefore branch on and copy uninitialized gathered arrays before the later scatter overwrites coordinates.
dispositions.rationale: X_TRACK_ALL/IN_CELL_ALL 는 myid==0 블록서만 채움(L444,464), 선택루프(L470-473)는 root 밖에서 IN_CELL_ALL/X_TRACK_ALL 읽음 → 비root 미정의 read. MPI UBA. base 미검출.

audit_member_text: MPI range/interface assumption: gather buffers are dimensioned NumberProcessor at L421-L426, while copy/fill/selection loops use px*py at L443, L453, L463, L471, L485, and L493. No local invariant establishes px*py==NumberProcessor; mismatch permits buffer overrun or leaves gathered ranks unexamined.

Input range gap: NumTracker is read without validation at L122 and immediately controls allocations at L125-L164 and loop bounds; malformed, zero, or negative counts and short per-tracker input are not checked locally.
